SELECT t.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode,
li.login_code AS id, e.name AS name,
li.profile_image AS profileImage, li.stamp_image AS signatureImage, li.stamp_image AS stampImage, li.password_hash AS password, NULL AS ihidNum, e.email AS email, e.department AS departmentName, NULL AS levelId, NULL AS levelCode, NULL AS levelName, CASE WHEN sr.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' THEN 'ADM' ELSE 'USR' END AS userSe, NULL AS orgnztId,
COALESCE(CAST(gu.user_id AS varchar), e.id) AS uniqId, NULL AS groupId, CASE WHEN sr.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' THEN 'ROLE_ADMIN' WHEN sr.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' THEN 'ROLE_TENANT_ADMIN' ELSE 'ROLE_USER' END AS groupNm, sr.role_code AS roleCode, sr.role_id AS roleId FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = li.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND COALESCE(t.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' JOIN employees e ON e.id = li.login_code LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT u.user_id FROM tb_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = li.tenant_id AND u.login_id = li.login_id ORDER BY u.user_id LIMIT 1 ) gu ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.role_code, lr.role_id FROM tb_login_account_role lr JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = lr.role_id WHERE lr.login_id = li.login_id AND r.tenant_id = li.tenant_id AND COALESCE(r.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' THEN 2 WHEN r.role_code = 'TENANT_USER' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, lr.role_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) sr ON TRUE
WHERE li.login_code = #{username} AND COALESCE(li.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' LIMIT 1

SELECT li.login_code AS id FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = li.login_id WHERE u.user_nm = #{name} AND u.email_addr = #{email}
AND li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint)
AND li.tenant_id = ( SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 )
AND COALESCE(li.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY li.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT li.password_hash AS password FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = li.login_id WHERE li.login_code = #{id} AND u.user_nm = #{name} AND u.email_addr = #{email}
AND li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint)
AND li.tenant_id = ( SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 )
AND COALESCE(li.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y'

SELECT li.login_code FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = li.login_id WHERE li.tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND u.email_addr = #{email} AND COALESCE(li.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY li.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id AS userId, gu.user_id AS employeeId, e.name AS name, e.email AS email, e.department AS departmentName, e.position AS levelName,
la.profile_image AS profileImage, la.stamp_image AS stampImage FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_code = e.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT u.user_id FROM tb_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = la.tenant_id AND u.login_id = la.login_id ORDER BY u.user_id LIMIT 1 ) gu ON TRUE WHERE e.id = #{loginCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT la.password_hash FROM tb_login_account la JOIN employees e ON e.id = la.login_code WHERE e.id = #{loginCode} AND la.tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_login_account SET profile_image = #{profileImage}, stamp_image = #{stampImage}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND login_code = #{loginCode}
